parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.text: Explain why the force due to air resistance acting on the ball may be neglected when calculating the time taken for the ball to reach the beam of light.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the time taken for the ball to fall from rest to position P where the bottom of the ball touches the beam of light.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Determine the time interval during which the beam of light is broken by the ball.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A different ball is released from the same position as the steel ball in (b). This ball has the same diameter but a much lower density. For this ball, the force due to air resistance cannot be neglected as the ball falls.

State and explain the change, if any, to the time interval during which the beam of light is broken by the ball.
